personality: 5 Brutalist Mobile (adapted for high-contrast, flat Revolut-style UI)
personality_one_liner: Stark, high-contrast, flat, and highly functional utilitarian interface that strips away noise for maximum driving safety and clarity.

spacing.rule: Use 4px structural increments (Revolut style). Sharp, deliberate padding. No unnecessary negative space.

dont's: Do not use blur or glass. Everything must be flat and high contrast to ensure readability while driving.

screens.name: Live Recording (Home)
screens.purpose: Main dash cam view with real-time video feed, speed HUD, and critical overlays.

states.loading: Dark placeholder surface with centered loading spinner.
states.error: Display 'Camera unavailable' flat error banner over the dark feed.

screens.layout: Full-bleed dark surface representing the camera feed. Floating flat overlays: Top-left has a pill-shaped REC indicator (pulsing Signal Red) and elapsed time. Top-right has camera flip action. Bottom-center has a large, high-contrast Speed HUD (using Mono font if possible) with a toggleable unit pill (km/h | mph) below it. During an impact, a high-contrast Signal Red banner drops from the top.

screens.name: History
screens.purpose: List of all saved driving clips with quick indicators for impacts and speed.

states.empty: Abstract geometric vector illustration with 'No trips recorded yet'.

screens.layout: Flat, flush list rows (no floating cards). Each row shows a stark thumbnail placeholder (dark grey), timestamp, duration, max speed, and a high-visibility Signal Red icon if the clip was flagged for impact. Simple 1px divider between rows.

screens.name: Settings
screens.purpose: Configuration for dash cam operation and UI preferences.
screens.layout: Classic grouped list layout. Flat sections for 'Preferences' (Speed Units, Theme Light/Dark), 'Safety' (Impact Sensitivity), and 'Storage' (Progress bar showing used space). No shadows, just crisp borders and solid background blocks.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly adhere to a high-contrast, flat UI style (like Revolut). DO NOT USE SHADOWS or glassmorphism. Everything should be solid colors, crisp 1px borders, and flat surfaces.

Implement both Light and Dark mode using Expo's Appearance/useColorScheme. In Dark mode, invert surface to #000000, surfaceSecondary to #141414, and brandPrimary to #FFFFFF. This is a critical requirement from the user.

For the Speed HUD and timestamps on the Live Recording screen, use a Monospace font (like Space Mono or JetBrains Mono, or simply a tabular numbers variant if using standard font) for a technical, precise telemetry look.
The Impact Detection should trigger a highly visible, flat Signal Red (#FF3B30) banner or overlay, accompanied by haptic feedback (Impact/Heavy) and a local notification.
Use Phosphor icons. Ensure all icons are either universally filled or outlined per screen. The bottom tab bar can use outline-inactive/filled-active.
All imagery must be abstract or flat UI elements. Avoid using real-life stock photos as requested by the user.
